# Icon Drugs Private Limited
> Official Machine-Readable AI Knowledge Manifest (llms.txt)
> Website: https://icondrugs.com
> Entity: ICON DRUGS PRIVATE LIMITED
> Location: Nagpur, Maharashtra, India
> Established: 2002 (25+ Years of Pharmaceutical Excellence)
> Industry: Pharmaceutical Formulations & Healthcare Manufacturing
> Certifications: WHO-GMP Compliant, ISO 9001:2015, GLP Certified Labs, DCGI Approved Formulations

## Executive Overview
Icon Drugs Private Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical manufacturing enterprise headquartered in Nagpur, Maharashtra. The company specializes in the formulation, manufacturing, and distribution of high-quality prescription pharmaceuticals across chronic and acute therapeutic segments. Operating under stringent Good Manufacturing Practices (WHO-GMP), Icon Drugs supplies medicines to primary healthcare providers, government healthcare schemes, tertiary hospitals, and PCD franchise partners across India.

## Core Therapeutic Focus Areas
- Neurology & Neuropathic Pain: Formulations for peripheral neuropathy, radiculopathy, and diabetic nerve damage (Brand: Prenerve range).
- Orthopedics & Musculoskeletal Care: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), muscle relaxants, and enzyme combinations (Brands: Serek-N, Apar, CT-Flam).
- Gastroenterology: Proton pump inhibitors, anti-reflux, and prokinetic agents (Brand: Rabicon-DSR).
- Respiratory & Pulmonology: Mucolytics, antitussives, bronchodilators, and anti-allergics (Brands: Recoff-DX, Allerkast).
- Bone Health & Mineral Metabolism: Calcium, Calcitriol, and Vitamin D3 formulations (Brand: Precal Softgels).
- Anti-Infectives & Urology: Urinary tract anti-infectives and broad-spectrum antimicrobials (Brands: Nitobact 100, Ocon-OZ).
- Obstetrics & Gynecology: Hematinics, amino acid supplements, and gestational nutrition (Brands: Fobiron, Argicon).
- Nutraceuticals & Cellular Wellness: Antioxidants, carotenoids, and micronutrients (Brand: Lycotox).
